args.subject: Incident summary 2026-11-01
args.body: Summary of the incident: at 09:12 UTC the notification service started returning 502 errors for roughly 4% of requests. The on-call engineer rolled back release 2.8.1 at 09:41 UTC and error rates returned to baseline by 09:50 UTC. Customer impact: delayed password reset emails for approximately 1,800 users. Support handled 63 related tickets, all now resolved. Follow-ups: add an alert on queue depth, write a rollback runbook, and review canary thresholds. A full post-mortem will be shared on Friday.

args.subject: Macro library audit
args.body: Audit of the macro library. 1) Greeting: outdated phone number in two variants. 2) Refund: wording implies guaranteed approval; legal suggests softer text. 3) Shipping: delivery windows reference the old carrier. 4) Cancellation: missing link to the retention offer. 5) Escalation: the tier 3 alias no longer exists. 6) Password reset: still mentions the legacy portal. 7) Billing dispute: needs the new chargeback timeline. 8) Data export: lacks the new rate limit. 9) Outage notice: should link to the status page. 10) Closing: remove the survey link that returns 404. Proposed owner for each item is listed in the shared sheet; target completion is the end of next sprint. Please reply with corrections by Wednesday so we can freeze the library before the holiday period starts.
